key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to query the codeburn CLI for updated metrics, in seconds. Range: 10–3600.

key.name: show-calls
key.summary: Show call count in panel label
key.description: When enabled the panel label shows "$1.63 / 184 calls". When disabled it shows only "$1.63".

key.name: codeburn-path
key.description: Absolute path to the codeburn executable (e.g. /home/user/.nvm/versions/node/v24/bin/codeburn). Leave empty to resolve "codeburn" from the system PATH.

key.name: provider-filter
key.description: Filter metrics by provider name (e.g. "claude", "copilot", "gemini"). Leave empty to include all providers.
